description: Attempt to register a new convention declaration into the sidecar's active session. This operation ALWAYS returns error:promotion-refused-during-session. The sidecar's convention registry is frozen at boot: declarations are loaded once from conventions/*.json when the sidecar starts and cannot be added, removed, or updated at runtime. This verb exists so the refusal is discoverable via tools/list and returns a predictable typed error instead of a generic 'no handler' response. To add a new convention, stop the sidecar, add the declaration JSON to conventions/, then restart — the new op will appear in tools/list on the next boot. This design is intentional: runtime promotion could allow an admitted agent to alter the verb surface mid-session, which violates the sidecar's trust model.

args.name: declaration
args.description: The convention declaration JSON to promote. Will be rejected — this arg is accepted for API symmetry with cf convention promote but is never acted upon.

common_mistakes: Expecting runtime promotion to work — it never does. The registry is frozen at boot. Stop the sidecar, add the declaration file, restart.
Confusing this op with cf convention promote (the cf CLI command that publishes to a registry campfire). This op is sidecar-internal and always refuses.
refuse_conditions: Always refused — returns error:promotion-refused-during-session regardless of the declaration content or the caller's identity.
